name: testland/d3-snapshot-tests
description: Snapshot-test D3.js charts - D3 generates SVG (not Canvas, per d3js.org getting-started); use `outerHTML` snapshot for static structure, `toHaveScreenshot` for rendered SVG; jsdom for headless render in unit tests; disable transitions for stable snapshots; per-element data-binding correctness tests. Use when a project renders charts with `d3.create('svg')` or D3 selections and the emitted SVG structure or update join needs regression coverage - including before a D3 major-version upgrade.
